content.title: Current disk health
content.query:
let Lookback = 20m;
let LatestPct = Perf
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
| where CounterName in~ ("% Free Space", "% Used Space")
| extend FreePct = iff(CounterName =~ "% Used Space", 100.0 - CounterValue, CounterValue)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, FreePct, Computer, _ResourceId) by _ResourceId, InstanceName;
let LatestMB = Perf
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
| where CounterName =~ "Free Megabytes"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, CounterValue) by _ResourceId, InstanceName
| project _ResourceId, InstanceName, FreeMB=CounterValue;
LatestPct
| join kind=leftouter LatestMB on _ResourceId, InstanceName
| extend FreeGiB = round(FreeMB / 1024.0, 2)
| extend State = case(FreePct < 10 or FreeGiB < 5, "Critical", FreePct < 20 or FreeGiB < 10, "Warning", "Healthy")
| project TimeGenerated, State, FreePct=round(FreePct, 1), FreeGiB, Computer, Disk=InstanceName, _ResourceId
| order by State asc, FreePct asc
